title: Little Worlds: Whimsical Fantasy Homes — 30 Printable Coloring Pages
purpose: First production candidate for Etsy validation. A cohesive set of cute, immersive fantasy homes and small environments, prioritizing open white coloring regions, broad shapes, and intentional objects.
success_criteria: Each page has one clear hero silhouette and three or four purposeful supporting objects.
All enclosed surfaces remain open white coloring regions, with black contour linework.
Details remain medium-large and reasonably consistent in density across pages.
A mix of fantasy homes, cozy interiors, and outdoor mini-worlds gives the book variety while maintaining a shared line-art style.
Every page passes full-resolution visual review before packaging.
